one_liner: Google's AI-powered research and note-taking assistant that synthesizes answers and audio overviews from user-uploaded sources; enterprise API is branded 'Gemini Notebook Enterprise'.

auth.notes: Consumer NotebookLM has no public API; only the Gemini Notebook Enterprise product (Google Cloud) exposes a preview API using gcloud/OAuth-issued bearer tokens.

access.evidence_quote: This feature is subject to the 'Pre-GA Offerings Terms'...Pre-GA features are available 'as is'
access.notes: Requires setting up Gemini Notebook Enterprise and obtaining licenses via Google Cloud; not self-serve, pre-GA/enterprise-only. No free consumer API.

api.notes: Only ~5 documented operations (create/get/list/delete/share notebooks); no official vendor MCP found, only unofficial community wrappers (nblm-rs, notebooklm-mcp-cli).

verdict.rationale: The consumer product has no public API and the only documented API is a pre-GA Google Cloud enterprise offering requiring licensing setup, not self-serve access.
